name: Being Sick
overview: Scripture reveals that God provides strength and care during times of sickness, as He supports the afflicted upon their beds and makes their rest secure. Believers are encouraged to trust wholly in the LORD rather than their own understanding, recognizing His healing power not only for physical ailments but also for broken hearts and wounds. A joyful spirit is portrayed as beneficial to health, while a broken or wounded spirit can deepen infirmity, underscoring the importance of spiritual well-being in the midst of physical weakness.
